segments.he: אָמַרמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל מִנָּבִיא עַל פִּי מִצְווֹת הַתּוֹרָה (עַיֵּן הוֹרָיוֹת י"ג):
segments.en: (18.) He said: "A king is greater than a prophet according to the commandments of the Torah." (See Horayos 13.)
